title: Veloce Rosso Australia's new precision radial velocity spectrograph
what_was_studied: Rosso arm architecture, calibration and early performance
numerical_result: Rosso covers about 580 to 930 nm at resolving power above 75000; sub-m/s was a design objective
remaining_question: Early performance and design objectives do not establish a long-baseline floor

title: Veloce community science verification
what_was_studied: New Verde and Azzurro channels and community verification
numerical_result: The new channels expanded coverage toward 378 nm, while detailed on-sky throughput was not yet measured
remaining_question: Flat-field comparison cannot replace stellar commissioning

title: Veloce spectrograph upgrade
numerical_result: The paper documents configuration expansion and ongoing performance verification
remaining_question: Each arm and overlapping-order region requires separate extraction validation

title: An automated reduction pipeline for non-RV science on AAT Veloce
numerical_result: The accepted paper states that overlapping images have limited RV precision and that no official public non-RV pipeline previously existed
remaining_question: A non-RV pipeline is not a validated precision-velocity pipeline

title: AAT instrumentation status
what_was_studied: Current Rosso availability and access conditions
numerical_result: AAT lists Rosso around 580 to 930 nm at resolving power about 80000 and offers Veloce on a shared-risk basis
remaining_question: Shared-risk availability should replace an unqualified operational label
